title: Daankat bi ci diggante ñaari horizon
intro: Ci téere yiy nettali jaar-jaaru Yàlla, amna nit ku wuute, di njiit lu am doole ak jaamu Yàlla bu woyof. Nit ki dafa tukki ba ci barab yi gëna sori ci kaw suuf, seede jant bi fenk ci kaw askan wu ñu xamul, ba noppi so ci ndox mu ñuul te lëndëm. Li gëna yéeme mooy surga boobu dañu ko sant mu tabax barab bu amul fenn ngir jàpp réew mu bari fitna. Ndax mën nga xàmmee nit ku mag kii ci Al Quran?
clues: Boroom yërmaande bi moo ma jox kàttan ak kàttan ci kaw suuf
Maa ngi tukki ci barab bi jant bi di fenk ak barab bi muy so
Ma yegg ci askan wu mënul dégg benn baat
Dañu ma sant ma tabax benn bariyer bu rëy ak weñ
Maa ngi tëj barab bi diggante ñaari tundu yu gaaw yi ak weñ wuy seey
Duma woon malaaka wala yonent waaye jaam la woon bu Yàlla gërëm

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
